title: Approaching stealers devs: a brief interview with Remus
content_md: To completely understand what’s going on in a market that has been growing in the last years I found mandatory to know which players are dominating it. Always remember that behind every user of the Internet there is another human like you, so if you can be kind enough to reach them and they agree, you can have a little talk. Asking things is not a crime. Please note everything that stated on this blog has only an informational purpose. I will never promote the use of these products. Let’s see today, a brief talk with Remus : The interview was made in Russian. Original answers and English translations are provided below. How would you describe Remus in simple terms? Ремус это синоним простоты, никаких сложных настроек, все готово к работе из коробки. Remus is synonymous with simplicity; there are no complex settings, and everything is ready to use out of the box Is there a story behind the name Remus? Ремус — один из братьев близнецов основавших Рим. Remus is one of the twin brothers who founded Rome. What makes Remus different from other products? Во времена нейросетей мы по прежнему пишем код в ручную, это обеспечивает хорошее качество как сборок так и панели. Положение каждой кнопкой выверено в ручную, а не сделано за вечер промптом. Even in the age of neural networks, we still write code manually. This ensures high quality for both the build and the panel.
